Do I need receipts? You never need to scan receipts to earn Cash Back. That’s too much work! All you have to do is join and shop on our website, the mobile app, or with the browser extension. Once you make an eligible purchase, we’ll add Cash Back to your account. Do I need to link a credit card? You don’t have to, but linking a card allows you to earn Cash Back in stores and restaurants. Add your card once, then pay with your linked card to automatically earn 5% Cash Back at 22,000+ restaurants nationwide (including drinks, tax and tip). To earn Cash Back in stores, add individual offers via the app and pay with your linked card. Can I use coupons? Yes, we offer coupons and promo codes that stack on top of Cash Back so you can maximize savings. In the browser extension, we automatically find coupons and apply them to your total at checkout. Start Earning Find restaurants in the Rakuten app Browse nearby Rakuten Dining offers, only in the Rakuten app. Don’t have the app? Scan the QR code to get it. Here’s how it works Join Rakuten and link a card Link as many as you like! All dining offers are automatically added when you link a card. Browse restaurants in the app Get the Rakuten app to see dining offers at thousands of restaurants. Dine and pay with your linked card Get 5% Cash Back on the entire bill—tax, tip and drinks included. That's it! Rakuten paid members over $2 billion in Cash Back There's a reason we're the #1 Cash Back shopping companion. Don't believe us? Just ask our community of 15 million members. More for you, all with Cash Back Earn on everything from clothes and electronics, to restaurants and travel. We’ll find you deals on more brands, apps and services so you can shop easy. Shop whenever you want, however you want Shopping smarter doesn’t have to be harder. Start with Rakuten via desktop, the App or our extension and let us do the deal-finding for you. Not a Cardholder? Apply Now Rakuten Dining FAQs How does Rakuten Dining work? Link a card to your account. Once linked, all dining offers are automatically added to your card. Browse restaurant offers in the Rakuten app by tapping In-Store, then Dining. Use your linked card to pay at participating restaurants. Cash Back will be added to your Rakuten account within 3 to 5 days after you dine. When will my Cash Back be confirmed? Cash Back on dining will be confirmed within 3 to 5 business days after you dine. Do I need to re-add the offer every time I dine? Nope! Earn Cash Back every time you dine at participating restaurants. No need to re-add offers for the same restaurant. I linked a card to Rakuten Dining offers, but I’m not earning Cash Back. Some Rakuten Dining restaurants do not offer Cash Back on certain days of the week. Check the restaurant page for details. Open the Rakuten App for Android or iOS. Tap on the In-Store tab at the bottom of the screen. Tap on Dining , then tap on any restaurant name to see the terms. If you don't see Cash Back in your account, use the Missing Cash Back form to let us know. You can also contact us with any questions. Can I earn American Express Membership Rewards® points in the Rakuten Dining program? Yes, as long as you selected American Express Membership Rewards® points as your payment method instead of Cash Back. See American Express Membership Rewards® Points at Rakuten Terms How do I find participating restaurants near me? In the Rakuten App, tap In-Store and filter by Dining. From there, you can see nearby participating restaurants. Can I use the same credit card to earn Cash Back with Rakuten and rewards/Cash Back from other dining-related programs? Rakuten Dining should be the only rewards program linked to your credit card. If there’s another dining rewards program you’d like to participate in, we recommend that you use a separate credit card. This will prevent another rewards program from overriding the Cash Back you earn with us. Please refer to your credit card’s terms and conditions as details may vary by card. In-Store Cash Back allows Rakuten members to earn Cash Back when shopping in person at participating local retail stores. Now you can earn online and in-store! How do I earn In-Store Cash Back? Earning Cash Back in store is simple! Just link one or more eligible American Express, Mastercard or Visa credit cards to your Rakuten account and add available In-Store Cash Back offers to your card(s). When you shop at participating local stores and pay with your eligible linked card, you’ll automatically earn Cash Back on qualifying purchases. Do I need to upload a receipt when I make a purchase? No, you don’t need to upload a receipt to earn Cash Back. Simply pay with the credit card that has your in-store offer. We do recommend that you keep your receipt in the rare event that you do not receive Cash Back as expected. We’ll need your receipt to verify your transaction. How do I know my credit card information is secure? Rakuten takes your privacy and security very seriously. Your credit card data is safely stored in a secure, encrypted environment that has been certified as compliant by the Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council (PCI). Visit PCI’s site to learn more about PCI compliance. For more information on how Rakuten handles your private information, please see Rakuten’s Privacy Policy and the In-Store Cash Back Terms & Conditions and Privacy Statement. Do all purchases qualify for In-Store Cash Back? Most in-store purchases at participating merchants are eligible for In-Store Cash Back. However, some stores may exclude certain products or categories from eligibility. For example, some merchants may not reward In-Store Cash Back for gift-card purchases or purchases within certain departments, such as pharmacy or automotive. Be sure to review any exclusions in the In-Store Cash Back offer details for each offer you add. Rakuten reserves the right to deduct Cash Back from your account if we determine that your purchase is for a product or category that is ineligible. Can I earn In-Store Cash Back for online purchases or orders placed at stores using their online ordering system? No. Rakuten In-Store Cash Back offers are valid only for purchases made in physical stores when you check out via a store register. You can still enjoy Cash Back for qualifying online purchases when you start your shopping trip at Rakuten.com. 	}

	margin-bottom: 10px;

  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr;

    grid-template-columns: 1fr;  /* stack into 1 column */

    grid-template-areas:

      "cats";

    order: 2;
  }
  #rr #home-main > :nth-child(2) { /* sidebar */
    order: 1;
  }
